content: MCP tools spec (official, 2026-07-28): tool fields name/title/description/inputSchema/outputSchema/annotations; outputSchema -> structuredContent, SHOULD also return serialized JSON as text content; execution errors returned as isError:true with actionable text (model self-corrects), protocol errors as JSON-RPC errors; tool names 1-128 chars, ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen/dot only; no protocol-level sessions - state passed explicitly or via opaque handles; servers MUST validate inputs; tool list SHOULD be deterministic for caching.
